## Checked

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `node --test tests/js/*.mjs` and `node --check` on each `static/*.js`
- [ ] Tried in a browser, if it touches the page script or styles
- [ ] A test comes with the change
- [ ] No keys, passwords or personal addresses in the diff, and no stored key reaches the browser or the logs
- [ ] README, `docs/ADAPTERS.md` or `CHANGELOG.md` updated, if behaviour changed
